title: Abundance of typical horseshoes for the random standard map
summary: We introduce a notion of typical horseshoe, consisting of a pair of rectangles admitting Markov returns at times of positive lower density, with controlled hyperbolic geometry and orbits that shadow typical trajectories. We prove the abundance of typical horseshoes for the random standard map and establish several statistical properties of the system, including exponential mixing and large deviation estimates for the associated projective and two-point processes.
